Ben  thanks for the recap. A couple clarifications and requests from our security team: 

1) SOC 2: we will need either the full Type II PDF or a SOC 2 bridge letter + summary. Prefer PDF behind SSO. If you require an NDA, let us know but we generally sign vendor NDAs for procurement.

2) Incident response / breach notification: can you provide the escalation timeline you operate under (e.g., detection -> containment -> notification) and typical notification SLAs for affected customers and regulators? 3) BCP / DR evidence: please upload your latest DR test report and the runbook. We typically ask for the last 12 months of test logs and any post-mortem for issues discovered in tests. If redactions are required, please mark them.

4) Questionnaire: we'll accept the PDF you attached. We prefer evidence uploaded to our secure vendor intake portal (link below). If Redwood has an existing HubSpot record or vendor ID, include it in the upload metadata.

Portal link: https://vendorportal.acmebank.com/upload (we'll send a direct intake token once we open the intake)

Cc'ing security@acmebank.com for any immediate questions.
